name: Ankoku Shinwa: Yamato Takeru Densetsu
original_name: 暗黒神話 ヤマトタケル伝説
source:
The game is based on old Japanese legends about Yamato Takeru, a legendary hero of ancient Japan. The game starts when Yamato Takeru is a thirteen-year-old boy. His father was killed under mysterious circumstances. Searching his things, the boy found a postcard that gave him his first clue for the investigation. From that moment, his adventure begins.

[From: [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/nes/ankoku-shinwa-yamato-takeru-densetsu]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
游戏改编自日本古代传说中的英雄日本武尊。故事开始时，日本武尊还是一名13岁少年，父亲在神秘情况下遇害。少年翻查父亲遗物，发现一张明信片，得到了调查案件的第一条线索。从这一刻起，他的冒险正式开始。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/nes/ankoku-shinwa-yamato-takeru-densetsu]MobyGames[/url]]
